_**Agent (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 2026-05-12 09:14:03Z)**_

Your remote `main` has commits you don't have locally. You need to integrate them first.

**Fix**: Run `git pull origin main` to fetch and merge remote changes, then push again.

**If you're certain your local history is correct and remote is wrong** (rare), use `git push --force-with-lease origin main` — but this rewrites shared history and will affect collaborators, so only do this if you've coordinated it.
